# Test fixture sources

- `pq_gradient.jxl`: from the libjxl test data
  (https://github.com/libjxl/testdata, `jxl/pq_gradient.jxl`), BSD 3-Clause
  license, copyright the JPEG XL Project Authors.
- `sdr8.jxl`: a 4x2 lossless 8-bit sRGB image made with libjxl for these tests.
- The `.jxr` files are generated by `make_hdr64.py` and `make_inputs.py`.
- `apple_gainmap_old.jpg`, `apple_gainmap_new.jpg` and `paris_gainmap.jpg`
  (renamed from `paris_exif_xmp_gainmap_littleendian.jpg`): from the libavif
  test data (https://github.com/AOMediaCodec/libavif, `tests/data`), BSD
  2-Clause license, copyright Joe Drago and the libavif authors. An iPhone
  JPEG with Apple's gain map and its headroom in the EXIF maker note, the
  same with the headroom in XMP, and an Ultra HDR (`hdrgm` XMP) JPEG with a
  per-channel maximum.
- `iphone_gainmap.heic` (renamed from `hdr-sample.heic`): from apple-hdr-heic
  (https://github.com/johncf/apple-hdr-heic, `tests/data`), MIT license,
  copyright 2024 John Charankattu. An iPhone HEIC with Apple's gain map.
